title: Montreal's 1976 Olympic Stadium: build time vs. debt payoff time

source.name: Olympic Stadium ("the Big Owe") debt retirement, paid off December 19, 2006
source.publisher: Régie des installations olympiques / widely reported (CBC, Reuters)

notes: The stadium was built in about 2 years (1973-1976); the debt it generated (further swollen by a 1974 fire and cost overruns) took 30 years to retire, finally paid off in 2006.

points.label: Years to pay off the debt
